annotations.title: Send money to someone on Morse

description: Asks the signed-in user to approve a payment to another Morse user. Use it when the user wants to send or pay money to someone on Morse. It does not send anything: the payment waits until the user approves it in the Morse app. With dry_run set it only returns what the user would pay and what the recipient would get; those numbers are a quote and are worked out again when the user approves. If the result has questions, ask the user and call again with the answers.

amount.description: Amount to send as a decimal string in currency followed by the ISO currency code, e.g. "50 USD" or "12.50 USD".

description.description: One line, in your own words, saying what the user asked for. The user sees it next to the request in the Morse app.

dry_run.description: Set to true to see what the user would pay and what the other side would get, without queueing anything. The numbers are a quote and are worked out again when the user approves.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Send the same key when retrying the same request so it is only queued once.

memo.description: Optional short note shown to the recipient. Leave empty unless the user gave one.

recipient.description: Who to pay: their Morse handle (e.g. @maria), their phone number in E.164 format, their email address or a persona id. If more than one person matches you will be asked which.

sender.description: Which of the users accounts is sending the money. If not provided, the main account of the user will be used. Leave empty unless asked during a response from the tool.

name: send_p2p
